definitions.explanation: The founder of Buddhism, named after the Shakya clan into which he was born. In speech he is usually お{釈迦|しゃか}{様|さま}; the name also lives on in several set phrases.

examples.japanese: {釈迦|しゃか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: To study the teachings of the Buddha.

examples.japanese: {四月八日|しがつようか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{釈迦|しゃか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: April 8 is traditionally kept as the Buddha's birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こつ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{釈迦|しゃか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説法|せっぽう}→説法：19138_seppou⟧だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Explaining cooking tips to a chef is like teaching your grandmother to suck eggs.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{釈迦|しゃか}⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧: the Buddha (the usual form in speech)
- {釈迦|しゃか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説法|せっぽう}→説法：19138_seppou⟧: preaching to the Buddha; explaining something to an expert
- お{釈迦|しゃか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: (slang) to be ruined, to turn out defective

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Buddha's birthday on April 8 is celebrated at temples as {花祭|はなまつ}り, when sweet tea is poured over a small statue of the infant Buddha.
